data.title: bn-23g: passive coherent Finding badge projection
data.description:
Review the one passive badge commit in Maw workspace bn-23g. Base d15aa6b15e84de7433e996578cd17e61e667725e and target 8a253abe347f93cb9c56f60703f5ddec979668f7. SHA-256 of git diff --binary --full-index --no-ext-diff over the exact range is cda47658dfc276782f3fa03f057291aa683752dffcfa8e76e03ff61a473d7caf.

The badge projects status, applicability, standing record details, and applicable policy provenance from one named coherent capture. Historical and ineligible reads withhold it. The full-depth CLI seam accepts a caller-supplied qualified Evidence instance. Stock dispatch still reports the Finding unavailable because it supplies no Evidence. Runtime authority, target acquisition, atomic publication, live F-48, and the end-to-end verify/show fixture remain outside this review.

Validation passed: serialized offline scourge-verify library suite (33 tests), scourge library and read_process, and cargo clippy --offline --workspace --all-targets --all-features --locked -- -D warnings. Full RUST_TEST_THREADS=1 CARGO_NET_OFFLINE=true just check passed on the host without added skips after two existing mocked worker-topology tests failed in the sandbox. The review covers deterministic SQLite status/deciding record selection, policy admission, an objection and binding-revision race, custody eligibility, and frozen JSON, text, and pretty output.

data.reason: LGTM at exact target 8a253abe347f93cb9c56f60703f5ddec979668f7. Independent full-index binary patch SHA-256 cda47658dfc276782f3fa03f057291aa683752dffcfa8e76e03ff61a473d7caf matched. One captured LinkedEvidenceSnapshot supplies status, applicability, standing eligibility, policy provenance, frozen badge fields, and lead revision; historical, unqualified, non-standing, lead, integrity-failure, and needs-review views cannot attach. The StatusComputer tuple refactor preserves audience, policy, refutation, and objection precedence. Stock dispatch passes no Evidence and read_process confirms no adapter, credential, or network access. Frozen JSON/text/pretty output and full-depth-only attachment qualify. Independent verifier 33/33, scourge lib 1/1 plus read_process, strict all-target/all-feature Clippy, and the complete serialized host just-check evidence are green. No findings.
